capabilities: Summarizes notes locally or with a local model
Suggests tags and merges them into frontmatter
Finds unlinked mentions and appends wikilinks
Sweeps folders for batch tag suggestions
extras: Offline-first: local commands make no network requests; the Ollama/OpenAI-compatible backend is optional. Scans are capped at 50 notes per run, and prompts are editable in data.json while Obsidian is closed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in summarization, tag suggestions or unlinked-mention linking, and cloud AI tools require sending note text off-device.

relations.evidence: Sends the note's plain text to a model served by Ollama

summary: Offline-first plugin that summarizes notes, suggests tags and unlinked links, optionally using a local Ollama model.
